# ResizeController

> Handles pointer-driven element resizing via a drag handle, dispatching `native:resize-start`, `native:resize-move`, and `native:resize-end`.

## Constructor

```ts
new ResizeController(host: HTMLElement, options?: ResizeOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `handleSelector` | `string` | yes |  |
| `axis` | `'horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'both'` | no |  |
| `min` | `number` | no |  |
| `max` | `number` | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |
| `reverse` | `boolean` | no | Reverse drag direction (e.g. left-edge handle that grows width on leftward drag). |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `native:resize-start` | `{ width, height }` |
| `native:resize-move` | `{ width, height }` |
| `native:resize-end` | `{ width, height }` |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `attach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `detach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { ResizeController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new ResizeController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
